rationale: Targeted re-check of the six blocking findings from code-review-final.json against the fix-up diff (317f720c..HEAD, 341 insertions across 5 files). All six are resolved. CR-001 and CR-002 were the two confirmed runtime defects and both now carry regression tests that fail against the old implementation: the CR-001 test uses a session double reproducing expire_on_commit plus close, and that double was verified to crash the old return-ORM-rows pattern (UnmappedInstanceError), so the test has teeth rather than passing vacuously. Test count rose 28 to 40 for the transfer suites; the combined run with the pre-existing project/user settings suites is 77 passed. make ruff and make license-check are clean. No new high-risk issue is suspected in the fix-up diff, so no confirmation pass was dispatched. business_review and standards_review are carried forward from the final round with the two rows the fixes changed updated in place.

finding_status.evidence: _apply now returns tuple[list[TransferredIntegration], bool]; DTOs and the has_litellm flag are materialized inside the loop before session.commit(), and transfer() reads no ORM attribute after the session closes. Regression tests TestApplyDoesNotLeakOrmState::test_move_payload_survives_commit_expiry and ::test_copy_payload_and_litellm_flag_survive_commit_expiry assert both that commit really expired the instances (row.__dict__ == {}) and that the payload is still intact.

_validate_aliases was split; _validate_aliases_present now runs over all candidates in transfer() before _partition, so alias-less trigger rows are rejected before skipped_payload is built. Test test_null_alias_trigger_row_is_rejected_before_response_construction asserts 422 naming the row id, and that get_session is never called.

TestCollisionMatrix adds the five spec section 5.1 cases with Settings.check_alias_unique unmocked (Settings.get_by_fields is faked one layer below, reproducing its equality-on-supplied-keys and first-match semantics, so the real rule executes). test_collision_mid_set_leaves_nothing_written covers spec section 6 atomicity. test_copy_preserves_every_clone_field asserts created_by, is_global, default, setting_hash and setting_type on the clone.
The 409 details and help now both name the target project and note the conflicting row may be project-scoped or owned by another user. Test test_conflict_help_names_the_target_project pins it.

.ai-run/sdlc-factory/doctor.json restored to the origin/main revision; git diff origin/main for that path is empty. A follow-up commit also untracked the generated code-review.diff artifact for the same reason.

All three new modules now open with from __future__ import annotations. typing.Optional and typing.List are gone: str | None, list[Settings], tuple[str, ...], tuple[list[Settings], list[Settings]] and tuple[list[TransferredIntegration], bool] replace them. make ruff passes.
